reason: #421 item 1: the router's `blocked` route (a connection whose port another node covers) gets one finite expansion budget for the whole route, shared by its segments, BLOCKED_EXPANSIONS (20,000); a route that spends it draws the direct line from end to end, as an end node sealed in already did. On the measured ~100-node graph (the MMO template with four blocked routes, one of them dragged) a blocked route took at most 13,517 expansions, so no route changed and the drawing is the same; the budget only bounds a larger graph.
